scope: Phase 1: lower new-entry sampling risk and separate optional JEV research from admission. Not a claim of repaired profitability or LIVE acceptance.

risk_activation.atomicity: Exact account, registry, binding and ACTIVE epoch under existing protocol/route locks; existing control role borrowed and restored on same transaction before policy CAS. No production privilege grants.
risk_activation.existing_reservations: Preserve original risk; remaining entry budget clamps to zero when existing risk exceeds the new ceiling. CLOSE remains available.
risk_activation.risk_meaning: Planned stop-loss risk, not margin allocation and not a guaranteed maximum realized loss under slippage, gaps or venue failure.

observer_contract.activation: Exact account selector outside repository; default and other accounts retain existing gate. SANDBOX futures only.
observer_contract.submission_point: After strategy admission, before final durable opportunity/account-risk dispatch. Observer cannot authorize or prove an order.
observer_contract.receipt: Non-durable submission or explicit missing coverage. Separate immutable binding/result records prove actual background observation.
observer_contract.budget: Existing shared coordinator and provider quota; no second allowance.
observer_contract.failure_effect: No veto, resize, defer or deadline extension. Oversized optional receipt is dropped before it can reject valid baseline evidence.
observer_contract.trade_link: NOT_PROVEN_EXECUTED until exact original decision linkage; later model results never become historical authorization.

shadow_quote_contract.source: Original durable directional-account-context public premiumIndex response, not a subsequent quote fetch.
shadow_quote_contract.clocks: Separate original mark, closed 1m candle and closed 15m indicator clocks; never re-clock stale candles.
shadow_quote_contract.verification: Background exact state_id PK/version/scope/symbol/price/time/public-response-digest validation before model access; private payload stays local.

reporting.label: 影子模式（不参与下单；模型评估另计）

subsequent_natural_entry.qualification: Natural legacy-clock shadow sample before the quote correction, not acceptance of the new quote contract or profitability proof.

remaining_evidence: Natural dual-clock provider results and representative shadow coverage after runtime correction; one prior OBSERVED result is not effectiveness evidence.
Prospective post-change settlements, costs and loss-tail comparison; no fabricated win-rate or profitability claim.
Intermittent signal-maintenance and lag evidence pre-exists this release. Latest CLEAR is not proof that its root causes are gone.
